description: Generate SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1 and MD5 digests for text or any file.

faqs.a: SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 use your browser's built-in WebCrypto engine. MD5 and SHA-1 are computed with audited pure-JavaScript implementations included on this page.
MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use (collisions can be forged). They are offered only for checksums and compatibility — use SHA-256 or SHA-512 for security.
faqs.q: Are MD5 and SHA-1 safe to use?

faqs.a: No. Files are read into memory and hashed locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Type text or choose a file to hash.
Copy any digest with its copy button.
Compare digests to verify file integrity or checksums.
title: Hash Generator
